GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to face breeze half off, pushed along turn, joined in Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m and dropped out # faced breeze

Jumped Fast Went Forward Five Wide of 5 early Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 1 1/2 Lengths had no favours Out On A Limb to Straightening Up , kept on tough to 200m Couldn'T Go On , Pace Suited Swoopers this # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear own terms, asked to go at the 400m Collared x 300m, # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, headed approaching 100m, kept on well b4 tiring late # led/weak L50m
Jumped Ok sat 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, headed 200m and dropped out # led/headed 200m

Jumped well. Rolled fwd to lead on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & held together Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pushed along @ 400m & pressured Four Wide @ 250m. Held them well in last 200m. # Led - controlled it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , led Two Wide but wanted to race keenly 1000m, Beaten on the corner and dropped out in Straight , Vet revealed no abnormalities # led/beaten turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When q’nd re riding through middle stages & whether was opportunity continue fwd leading pos on rail. App. std mnt had tenancy to race keenly & if allowed mnt to continue fwd at which time felt was already travelling at strong tempo mnt may not have settled. Further added in opinion was on superior ground being one off rail compared to on rail. In terms of whether there was an opportunity to restrain mnt middle stages added was reluctant to restrain due mnt previous history of racing keenly. A post-race vet exam rev no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear and kept going strong to the line # led/no danger
Jumped okay & Settled Down 3rd trailing 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, Headed rounding turn then kept trying in Straight # battled on fairly
Jumped Ok rolled forward to face breeze 1 length off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on strong to the line, just no match leader/winner # breeze/leader won
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced ungenerously in the early and middle stages, when racing wide and without cover. Was then allowed to stride forward to obtain a position outside the leader near the 1000m.
